## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to tag a [`gmeow:Prompt`](../classes/gmeow-Prompt.md) with the conversational role it occupies — system, user, assistant, or tool — drawn from the [`gmeow:PromptRole`](../classes/gmeow-PromptRole.md) vocabulary.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting several roles on one prompt (it is functional — one prompt, one role; a multi-role turn is several prompts) and avoid minting a per-role subproperty (the role is a value).

### How to use

- Assert exactly one [`gmeow:promptRole`](gmeow-promptRole.md) per [`Prompt`](../classes/gmeow-Prompt.md) at a [`gmeow:PromptRole`](../classes/gmeow-PromptRole.md) individual; mint a fresh individual if a needed conversational role is not seeded, since the vocabulary is open.

### Examples

- ex:sysPrompt [`gmeow:promptRole`](gmeow-promptRole.md) [`gmeow:promptRoleSystem`](../individuals/gmeow-promptRoleSystem.md).
